app.title: Prepaid Meter Helper
app.tagline: Bangladesh • Recharge, slabs & tokens — everything in one place
prov.hint: Type in Bengali or English numerals. Settings are saved automatically.
rech.formula: Formula: recharge minus arrears → separate 5% VAT → minus meter rent & demand charge → plus 0.5% prepaid rebate = energy credit.
rech.why1: VAT treatment — calculated as 5% VAT-inclusive here; your receipt may present it differently.
rech.why2: Previous arrears or instalment adjustments may be deducted from the token.
rech.why3: Three-phase or special connections may carry different rent/charges.
rech.why4: If BERC revises tariffs before tariffs.json is updated, old rates will show — check the verified date below.
rech.disc: Remember: this is an estimate. Actual tokens may include arrear adjustments or extra charges — match with your receipt before deciding.
rech.empty: Enter the amount on the left and press “Calculate”.
slab.note: Residential (LT-A) slabs apply. Lifeline rate only if total use is within 50 units.
tok.label: Type or paste the token number
tok.tips_h: How to enter the token on your meter
tok.tip1: Enter 4 digits at a time and match them — don't rush.
tok.tip2: On a mistake the meter shows “Error/EEE” — start over from the beginning.
tok.tip3: If there are multiple tokens, enter them in order (1st, 2nd…).
tok.tip4: On success the meter beeps and shows the balance.
use.log_h: Reading log (stays only on your phone)
ap.whatif: “What if I run the AC 2 hours less?” — drag the slider
gas.t1: Prepaid card recharges add gas credit after VAT & charges — check the breakdown on your receipt.
gas.t2: Recharge before the balance runs out; any emergency balance is adjusted later.
gas.t3: If you suspect a leak, call the Titas emergency number quickly — never try to fix it yourself.
gas.soon: Full gas calculator coming soon — share feedback on GitHub.
gas.w1: Residential water bills are stepped by unit (1000 litres) and connection size.
gas.w2: Sewerage charge applies in covered areas on top of the water bill.
gas.w3: For an abnormal bill, photograph the meter reading and complain at the office.
gas.soon2: WASA slab calculator will be added in the next release.
foot.privacy: 100% offline. No tracking. Your data never leaves this device.
foot.disc: Estimated figures — cross-check with your bill/receipt before deciding. Not legal or engineering advice.
dyn.explain: From your Tk {gross} recharge: meter rent Tk {rent}, demand charge Tk {dem} and VAT Tk {vat} will be deducted; with Tk {reb} rebate added, you get ≈ Tk {energy} for energy.
dyn.warn_fixed: Warning: meter rent + demand charge exceeds the recharge — a small top-up may be fully eaten by fixed charges.
dyn.tok_ok: Correct! 20 digits matched — ready to enter on the meter.
dyn.en_fail: English pack failed to load — use the hosted link.
dyn.use_days: Balance will last ≈ {d} days at current pace
dyn.use_days_inf: Balance looks enough to cross the month.
dyn.use_note: Note: forecast is approximate, based on daily average — weather, holidays or new appliances can change it.
dyn.log_bad: Give a valid date and reading.
dyn.ap_save: Running AC {h} hrs/day costs ≈ Tk {tk}/month ({kwh} units).
dyn.stale: Data may be older than 6 months — match with your receipt.
